About Me

Data analytics + audio post: Python/R/SQL, data pipelines & insights—alongside podcast editing, mixing, and composition.

Who I Am

I'm Tai Heard—a Data analytics + audio post: Python/R/SQL, data pipelines & insights—alongside podcast editing, mixing, and composition. I've learned that the difference between a clean mix and a clean dataset is smaller than you might think: both are about indentifying what matters, removing what doesn't, and making the result easy to work with.

My Journey

Professionally, I've moved between analytics work (Python, R, SQL; building tools and keeping databases healthy) and audio work (podcast editing, game music, post-production). The consistent thread is the same kind of focus: pattern recognition, taste, and iteration—test, adjust, listen/read, repeat.

What You'll Find Here

  • Data projects with a point of view — analysis that leads to decisions, not just charts
  • Audio work with intention — edits, mixes, and compositions built for clarity and feel
  • Crossover experiments — where code supports creative workflow (and where sound becomes another way to explore information)

Fun fact: The same "remove the noise, keep the story" mindset I use in dialogue cleanup is exactly how I approach data cleaning and QA.
